description: Image pins live in TypeScript; .tektonic/ is synthesized from it. The Ansible manager matches .tektonic/tasks/*.k8s.yaml by accident of the path, so bumps used to land in the emitted YAML while the source that generates it stayed behind — and the next `tektonic synth` reverted them. .tektonic is ignored above; these are the files that actually own a version.
config:recommended ignores examples/ by default, which is why ignorePaths is spelled out here without it.
Add a file when it grows a versioned image literal. Unversioned tags (base:stable) are left alone by the leading digit required of currentValue.
